items.english: "Why are you so quiet?" the man said, looking at the woman's face in puzzlement. She hurriedly tried to say something, but unable to say anything all at once she fell silent, and her eyes again ran far off. And she saw the picture like a phantom again. Then for the first time she quietly heard the sound of the storm outside the door. She said nothing.
notes: Japanese has doushite here and naze in p21 for the same repeated question; I have kept the English identical.

items.english: Yes. That day was there. The day when all would turn to fond remembrance and forgiveness and peace was there. After a long life, and after a long sorrow, and after a long suffering, on the day after all of that, that peaceful day of fond remembrance and forgiveness was there. What was the suffering or sorrow of each single day. What was the tiredness or trouble of each single day. Before she knew it she had a smile on her face.
notes: Kept that day unresolved and repeated long, all, and smile as in the Japanese.

items.english:
"Why are you so quiet?" the man spoke to her again.

She raised her head as if startled and, smiling fondly, said as if asking him too to remember many things, even the happy things from before their marriage, "Really only a little time has passed since we were married, hasn't it."
notes: Grouped as one item because p21 breaks off in the middle of her action into the speech in p22, with p23 as its close.

items.english: "That's so," the man too raised his eyes and said.
"It is only three years, isn't it. And yet you and I have been through a great deal."
notes: Kept only three years in plain words for the return to ordinary time.

items.english: "Truly." She lowered her eyes again to try to look at that picture. But at once, "But it is still only three years, you know," she said, her eyes shining as if she must tell him of some great hope, though she herself did not know what it was.
notes: Grouped as one item because p26 breaks off into the speech in p27. Kept only three years in the wife's same plain refrain and left the great hope unexplained.

data.say: Drafted the quiet return from vision to table, keeping that day and only three years plain.
